title: Diagnostic Review: Conformal Prediction Covariate Shift & Miscalibration Audit
description: Inspect a split conformal calibration pipeline for covariate population drift neglect, missing finite-sample sample size adjustments, and unhandled NaN residual propagation.

artifact.content:
import numpy as np
from scipy import stats

class ConformalCalibrator:
    def __init__(self, alpha: float = 0.10):
        self.alpha = alpha
        self.q_hat: float | None = None

    def calibrate(self, y_true: np.ndarray, y_pred_lower: np.ndarray, y_pred_upper: np.ndarray):
        # Residual computation without NaN validation silently propages invalid residuals
        residuals = np.maximum(y_pred_lower - y_true, y_true - y_pred_upper)
        n = len(residuals)
        
        # Standard quantile without finite-sample (n+1)/n correction violates coverage guarantee
        self.q_hat = float(np.quantile(residuals, 1.0 - self.alpha))

    def predict_interval(self, point_preds: np.ndarray, incoming_features: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
        # Applying fixed calibration under extreme covariate shift without drift audit
        # Drifting feature distributions invalidate exchangeability assumption
        lower = point_preds - self.q_hat
        upper = point_preds + self.q_hat
        return np.column_stack([lower, upper])

defects.title: Unsanitized Residual Computation Allowing Silent NaN Propagation
defects.consequence: Missing NaN checks in non-conformity score calculation allows missing data to silently contaminate q_hat, corrupting prediction bounds.
defects.diagnostic_explanation: Assert absence of NaNs and infinities in y_true and predictions prior to residual evaluation, or filter invalid samples with explicit telemetry.

defects.title: Empirical Quantile Computation Lacking Finite-Sample Correction Factor
defects.consequence: Using standard continuous np.quantile without the ceil((n+1)*(1-alpha))/n finite-sample adjustment under-covers nominal 1-alpha confidence.
defects.diagnostic_explanation: Compute conformal non-conformity threshold using quantile index p = np.ceil((n + 1) * (1 - alpha)) / n clipped to 1.0.

defects.title: Applying Conformal Intervals Across Undetected Covariate Shift
defects.consequence: Deploying fixed non-conformity scores without monitoring covariate distribution drift violates exchangeability, causing empirical coverage degradation.
defects.diagnostic_explanation: Implement KS-test or Population Stability Index (PSI) drift monitoring on incoming feature batches and trigger recalibration when shift is detected.
